import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_paths = {
    "Source5_3_0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/training_0.csv",
    "Source5_3_1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/training_1.csv",
    "Source5_3_2": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/training_2.csv",
    "Source5_3_3": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/training_3.csv",
    "Source5_3_4": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/training_4.csv",
    "Source5_3_5": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/training_5.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_paths["Source5_3_0"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Albums in RS500']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_paths["Source5_3_1"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Top 100 Singles', 'Highest Position']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_paths["Source5_3_2"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Certified Units (Millions)']
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_paths["Source5_3_3"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated']
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_paths["Source5_3_4"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Influenced']
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_paths["Source5_3_5"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Inducted By']

# Step 2: Resolve overlapping columns and prefer the more complete source for those columns
# Columns 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated' appear in both df3 and df5.
# df5 has an additional 'Inducted By' column, so we will use df5's values for these columns where available.
# For artists missing in df5, fallback to df3.

# Merge df3 and df5 on 'Artist' to combine these columns, prioritizing df5's data
df_years = pd.merge(
    df3,
    df5[['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Inducted By']],
    on='Artist',
    how='outer',
    suffixes=('_3', '_5')
)

# For each overlapping column, choose df5's value if present, else df3's
def coalesce(row, col):
    if pd.notna(row[f"{col}_5"]):
        return row[f"{col}_5"]
    else:
        return row[f"{col}_3"]

df_years['Year Inducted'] = df_years.apply(lambda r: coalesce(r, 'Year Inducted'), axis=1)
df_years['Years Waited'] = df_years.apply(lambda r: coalesce(r, 'Years Waited'), axis=1)
df_years['# of Years Nominated'] = df_years.apply(lambda r: coalesce(r, '# of Years Nominated'), axis=1)
df_years['Inducted By'] = df_years['Inducted By']  # from df5, may have NaNs if missing

# Keep only needed columns now
df_years = df_years[['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Inducted By']]

# Step 3: Merge all other source tables on 'Artist'
# Start with df_years as base, then merge df0, df1, df2, df4

# Merge df0: ['Artist', 'Albums in RS500']
df_merge = pd.merge(df_years, df0, on='Artist', how='outer')

# Merge df1: ['Artist', 'Top 100 Singles', 'Highest Position']
df_merge = pd.merge(df_merge, df1, on='Artist', how='outer')

# Merge df2: ['Artist', 'Certified Units (Millions)']
df_merge = pd.merge(df_merge, df2, on='Artist', how='outer')

# Merge df4: ['Artist', 'Influenced']
df_merge = pd.merge(df_merge, df4, on='Artist', how='outer')

# Step 4: Ensure all target columns are present and have correct types
# Target schema:
# ['Artist': string,
#  'Year Inducted': float,
#  'Years Waited': integer,
#  '# of Years Nominated': integer,
#  'Inducted By': string,
#  'Influenced': integer,
#  'Certified Units (Millions)': float,
#  'Albums in RS500': integer,
#  'Top 100 Singles': integer,
#  'Highest Position': integer]

# Convert columns to correct types, handling missing values appropriately

# Artist: string, fill missing with empty string (unlikely)
df_merge['Artist'] = df_merge['Artist'].astype(str)

# Year Inducted: float (NaNs allowed)
df_merge['Year Inducted'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Year Inducted'], errors='coerce')

# Years Waited: integer, convert with NaNs to Int64 dtype (nullable integer)
df_merge['Years Waited'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Years Waited'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# # of Years Nominated: integer, nullable
df_merge['# of Years Nominated'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['# of Years Nominated'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Inducted By: string, fill NaNs with empty string
df_merge['Inducted By'] = df_merge['Inducted By'].fillna('').astype(str)

# Influenced: integer, nullable
df_merge['Influenced'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Influenced'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Certified Units (Millions): float
df_merge['Certified Units (Millions)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Certified Units (Millions)'], errors='coerce')

# Albums in RS500: integer, nullable
df_merge['Albums in RS500'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Albums in RS500'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Top 100 Singles: integer, nullable
df_merge['Top 100 Singles'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Top 100 Singles'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Highest Position: integer, nullable
df_merge['Highest Position'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merge['Highest Position'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Step 5: Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Artist',
    'Year Inducted',
    'Years Waited',
    '# of Years Nominated',
    'Inducted By',
    'Influenced',
    'Certified Units (Millions)',
    'Albums in RS500',
    'Top 100 Singles',
    'Highest Position'
]

df_final = df_merge[target_columns]

# Step 6: Export the final dataframe to the target CSV path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_3/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

# Because Source5_3_5 has 'Inducted By' which Source5_3_3 lacks, join to enrich the data
join_3_5 = pd.merge(source3, source5, how='outer', on=['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated'])

# Join Source5_3_2 and Source5_3_4 on Artist

# Join join_0_1_3_5 with join_2_4 on Artist

# The resulting dataframe has all columns from all sources, but some columns may be duplicated or redundant
# The target schema is:
# ['Artist': string, 'Year Inducted': float, 'Years Waited': integer, '# of Years Nominated': integer, 'Inducted By': string,
